newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour proposes Food Standards Agency.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour proposes Food Standards Agency.

text.p: Britain's main opposition Labour Party said on Thursday it would set up an independent Food Standards Agency if it comes to power as part of a drive to ensure food is safe to eat.

But agriculture spokesman Gavin Strang said he could not claim that such an agency would necessarily have prevented the current outbreak of food poisoning in Scotland, which has so far killed five people.
"A Labour government will put food safety at the top of the agenda," Strang told a news conference. "The government has not given food safety the priority it ought to have had."
Scottish Secretary Michael Forsyth is to make a statement to the Commons at 1530 GMT about the food poisoning outbreak in central Scotland in which over 100 people are ill.
The organism responsible is a dangerous strain of E coli, a common gut bacterium that normally is harmless.
